findings.problem: Post/event cover images, media thumbnails and YouTube embeds are stored but no public component renders them yet (only SiteSettings.logoUrl is shown), so 'For now, paste an image link or a YouTube link' implies a public effect that doesn't exist in this phase.
findings.fix: Extend the hint and the README admin guide to say links are saved now and appear once the media/detail pages arrive, or render thumbnailUrl on the home featured cards.

findings.problem: The single UPLOAD_HINT constant tells users to paste 'a YouTube link' into image-only fields (post/event cover, settings logo); optionalSafeUrl accepts it, so a YouTube page URL could be stored as an image source.
findings.fix: Use field-specific wording ('paste an image link') on image fields and keep the YouTube wording on the media video field.

findings.problem: At 1280x900 the last sidebar item 'Log out' is cut off at the bottom edge (dashboard-1280.png).
findings.fix: Tighten sidebar spacing or pin the session/logout block to the sidebar bottom.
